title: Two independent screenings
description: Synthetic fan-in fixture. Both screening outcomes must be clear to approve; either hit declines. Missing outcomes escalate.

decision.intent: Decide whether the vendor proceeds to onboarding once the screening decision is known.
decision.question: Should this vendor be onboarded, given the screening decision's outcome?

outcomes.label: Approve
outcomes.description: The screening decision cleared the vendor.

outcomes.label: Decline
outcomes.description: The screening decision matched the vendor.

rules.rationale: A screening that resolved nothing is not a clearance, and this pack never infers one.
The same missing status blocks a decline for the same reason it blocks an approval.

escalation.message: Escalate a vendor whose screening decision cannot be established.
